Start in the browser. Continue with your assistant.

  1. Open VoiceCall AI, sign in with Internet Identity, and buy phone time with Stripe in the dashboard.
  2. In an MCP-compatible assistant, add the official connector URL:
    https://mcp.internetcomputer.org/mcp
    See DFINITY's ICP MCP setup. Connector availability depends on your assistant and account.
  3. Enable AI access in Internet Identity where prompted. Authorize this app, https://voicecallai.online, using the same Internet Identity. Select “Actions and questions” for purchases, presets, and calls.
  4. Ask the assistant to read the agent instructions, call getAgentGuide, initialize your app account, and check your available phone time. Compare account identifiers with Settings before paying again. If balances differ, use the account-linking controls in Settings; do not assume accounts match just because you used the same assistant.
  5. Confirm the recipient in international format, the call purpose, an agent preset, and recording/transcript choices. The assistant queues the call and, once it is live, receives a listen-only audio link in the job status. It should give you that link without waiting for you to ask. It can also cancel or end its own call jobs.

Try asking: “Read https://voicecallai.online/llms.txt and use ICP MCP to check my phone time. Help me prepare a call, and ask me to confirm the recipient and instructions before dialing.”

Prefer to pay with ICP?

  1. Have your assistant call agentGetAccountIdentity and show the exact depositAccount returned. This is an ICRC-1 owner and subaccount, not a guessed address.
  2. Transfer ICP to that account, keeping enough for the quoted purchase and ledger fee. Do not send deposits directly to the operator treasury address.
  3. Check agentGetAccountStatus. Refresh pricing only when stale, then authorize a specific package. agentPurchasePhoneTime debits deposited ICP and credits seconds.
  4. Use one unique idempotency key per intended purchase; retry an uncertain result with the same key. Verify the resulting phone-time balance before retrying payment.

Already bought time with Stripe? No ICP deposit is needed to use that time from the same app account.

Reaching the right person through a phone menu

Outbound agents listen to phone menus and press the announced option, including customer service or voicemail. Put the destination in the preset. If the person has an extension, write it as extension 104. The agent enters that extension when the recording asks for it, and adds # only when the prompt asks for the pound key.

On a voicemail greeting, the agent stays quiet until the beep, leaves one short message, and hangs up after it plays. Include the reason for the call and a real callback number, or say that no voicemail should be left. A full or unavailable mailbox can be ended without a message. A short “hello” is treated as a person. Silence alone is not treated as voicemail.

Menus, hold, and the voicemail greeting use the same prepaid phone time as the rest of the call. Pressing keys does not add an Internet Computer charge. These behaviors come from the voice bridge, so existing presets pick them up without a migration. Updating the website alone does not change a bridge that has not been restarted.

Good to know

Do I need my own Twilio or xAI account?

Outbound calls use the service's voice bridge. Your assistant does not need separate Twilio or xAI tools. Inbound AI answering requires a Twilio number you own and access to its Voice webhook settings. Create an answering preset, paste the returned webhook URL in Twilio, verify by calling the number, and enable the verified preset.

Can an assistant read my calls just by visiting the site?

No. Public documentation describes the service. Account access requires authentication and authorization. A compatible assistant can use the backend Candid API; a text-only assistant can explain the guide but cannot place a call without appropriate tools.

What happens to recordings and transcripts?

Choose capture options before calling. Saving either requires confirmation of applicable participant consent. Account and call records are stored in the IC backend; real-time audio is processed by the off-chain voice bridge, Twilio, and xAI. Audio recordings stay off-chain. Treat transcripts, webhook secrets, and signed recording or listening URLs as private. Capture being disabled does not mean the call avoids real-time processing by those providers.

What if my call or payment is delayed?

Check account status or call history before trying again. Agents should poll jobs with 10–30 second backoff and reuse the same idempotency key for the same action. Only report completion when the returned state confirms it. You can end a queued or dispatched agent call with agentEndCall; bridge dispatch of hang-up is asynchronous.

Every call carries responsibility

VoiceCall AI is a tool for placing and answering calls with AI agents. You are responsible for following the laws that apply where you and the other person are located. Before you use the app, you accept terms that stay in effect for six months or until they change.

Harmless pranks and adult roleplay between adults are allowed. Threats of violence, blackmail, swatting, and sexual content involving anyone under 18 are not. Do not call emergency services, crisis lines, police dispatch, or a government office to make a report or a false claim of official business. Do not impersonate police, emergency services, a court, or another government agency. The app filters known emergency short codes and reserved number patterns. This cannot identify every full-length government number. Do not attempt to bypass a blocked call by rewriting the number.

Some places allow a recording when one person agrees. Others require every person on the call to agree. The terms tell you that difference. If you record audio or save a transcript, you are responsible for getting whatever permission that call requires. End the call if the other person asks you to stop.
